llm_response.reason: The website uses the name 'TikTok-Wholesale' in an apparent attempt to impersonate the legitimate TikTok brand (scam characteristic #16). The site offers unusually large discounts and rare urgency sales tactics, hallmarks of fake online shops (characteristics #1, #13). There's no legitimate business contact, no product navigation links, and the site was registered only recently with privacy-protected WHOIS. All of these factors together, as well as the lack of real company info or verifiable branding, are hallmarks of a scam 'Fake Online Shopping' website.
